hints.title: Order Invariance of Subsequences
hints.text: Subsequences can reorder elements arbitrarily. Sorting nums allows grouping elements into contiguous ranges.

hints.title: Greedy Span Anchor
hints.text: Anchor the start of each subsequence at the current smallest unassigned number.

hints.title: Subsequence Breakpoint Condition
hints.text: Whenever nums[i] - anchor > k, start a new subsequence anchored at nums[i].

hints.title: Sorted Greedy Partition Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting takes O(n log n); linear pass takes O(n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Partitioning without sorting leads to intractable subset search.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place sort takes constant extra space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate proves that extending each group as far as possible under range k is optimal.
